read_extent.submission: Selected physical pages 25–27 and 29–31, including the complete local integration argument and the claim on page 30; not all 45 pages. Earlier separate Android review covered pages 1–2 and 7–9.
read_extent.government_bill: Exact BT 21/8279 physical pages 113, 121 and 125; table 4.16 and the corresponding explanation independently read.

assessment: The bill positively includes EUR 270,000 in one-off compliance costs for the same § 345a digital-entry feature, allocated to health insurers. Thus a literal assertion that the cost assessment entirely omits this feature would be inaccurate. But the statement does not explicitly identify the Erfüllungsaufwand table or assert a zero entry. The surrounding argument concerns an integrated pathway and the prediction of a media break. Costs being envisaged may refer to actual resources or reimbursement, or insufficient integration funding, rather than the existence of an estimate. An administrative cost estimate does not appropriate funding. This concrete alternative prevents promotion as a proven draft-description error.
limits: No conclusion that EUR 270,000 funds an adequate complete pathway.
The author’s separate EUR 100 million expectation is a forecast; the government’s smaller estimate does not disprove it.
No actual burden, appropriated funding, platform availability or policy outcome is established.
No additional author quotations reproduced in this review.
severity_and_direction: Minor potential supporting-premise issue; direction remains null while intended meaning is unresolved. Conditional literal interpretation would support the author’s integration request, but that conditional hypothesis is not a demonstrated direction.
